Feature names for a pooled stage

Source: R/hierarchy_poolers.R
pooler_feature_names.Rd

Builds the column names that match the output of pool_activations, in the same order. Names have three tokens separated by "::": the stage, the zero-padded channel, and the spatial feature, for example b3::channel_017::dct_y0_x1.

Usage

pooler_feature_names(pooler, stage, n_channels, spatial = NULL)

Arguments

pooler

An imfeatures_pooler.

stage

Stage name used as the first token.

n_channels

Number of channels, or the number of dense features when spatial is NULL and the pooler is identity.

spatial

Optional integer length-2 spatial size c(H, W) for identity flattening of 4-D maps.

Value

A character vector with one name per pooled column.

Details

PoolerSpatial token
global_average_pool()gap
global_max_pool()gmp
adaptive_grid_pool()grid_y<row>_x<col> (one-based cell)
dct_pool()dct_y<v>_x<u> (zero-based frequency)
radial_pool()radial_r<ring> (one-based, centre outwards)
identity_pool() on a 4-D mapy<row>_x<col> (one-based position)
identity_pool() on a dense layerstage::f_001 (two tokens)

See also

pool_activations, poolers.

Examples

pooler_feature_names(global_average_pool(), "b5", 2)
#> [1] "b5::channel_001::gap" "b5::channel_002::gap"
pooler_feature_names(dct_pool(2, 2), "b5", 1)
#> [1] "b5::channel_001::dct_y0_x0" "b5::channel_001::dct_y0_x1"
#> [3] "b5::channel_001::dct_y1_x0" "b5::channel_001::dct_y1_x1"
pooler_feature_names(identity_pool(), "b5", 1, spatial = c(2, 2))
#> [1] "b5::channel_001::y1_x1" "b5::channel_001::y2_x1" "b5::channel_001::y1_x2"
#> [4] "b5::channel_001::y2_x2"
pooler_feature_names(identity_pool(), "fc1", 3)
#> [1] "fc1::f_001" "fc1::f_002" "fc1::f_003"
